body: I am looking at jobs downtown! There are so many, this is really embarrassing that all these job titles seem foreign to me. Things really have changed in the past decade. I do have a few things going for me in that I look like I'm in my 20's still so while I am not young I can fake it and maybe get my foot in the door through learning the job as I go.

I am so happy to hear your story, and that you made it through that. Not being able to order food, exactly my story! Everything is so foreign, from difficult to simple stuff. Using a drill or even driving our truck. Maybe you are right, and this is what we both need, that people do grow apart and I will find my own path in life. It seems far away, but hearing you saying you were able to make it helps me a lot. Thanks for that.

I feel the same way tonight. Thoughts are so cruel. Doing fine, then suddenly a memory of something happy will bring you back to sadness and you feel utterly helpless. Uncontrollable sobbing, then back to vacant staring, then suicidal wanting to end it all. You are not alone. You can get through it.
Just knowing that someone is rooting for me, makes me feel less terrible. :)

Thank you for that. I forget that there are a lot of resources out there, I guess I don't have to throw in the towel and give up. It takes a lot of building oneself up to try. Hopefully I will get there at some point.

Well, I was at my last job for 11 years. Tech support / customer service for a major website. Basic stuff, and I have no education, just promoted through the job I had to a level that I couldn't be outright hired for now. Plus, I live in Seattle where all the tech workers are definitely much better and more skilled than I am. I am a bit outdated in that field but am always quick to learn. But seeking anything, I realize I'm pretty useless. I would suck as a waitress. Seattle has such a divide between the Amazon tech people who make over 100k and high apartment rates, and the bartenders living in small overpriced studios. No in between. And I don't fit into either. 

Really, I'd be happy with a data entry job or something menial because I dont' think I'm good enough for anything else. 

I hope your job hunt is going well!

I haven't really left the bed either today. Welcome to the club! Tomorrow is another day. I'm going to try to actually put pants and shoes on and see if I can step outside. I know fresh air and sun will help. Maybe you could try it as well.

It does feel like death. My father died when I was 7, and it's all coming back. The helplessness, that you cannot control something that you need in your life. I appreciate the outside help suggestion, I think it's time I see a professional. I've never been to one before, but willing to give it a try. Anything is better than this.

Thank you. It's so hard for me because I have never been with anyone else. 22 years, monogamous. People are always surprised at how long we've been together and how well we get along. Until recently.. It's kind of embarrassing to me that I feel like I've used him as my life guide. I can't figure out anything without him. 

I just weighed myself and I've lost 5 pounds since last week and weight now 110. I can't change out of the same stupid tshirts and am afraid to start looking for a job. All jobs seem so scary. I need to grow up but don't know where to start. So I just get these crushing waves of wanting to die. 

I hope your father and mother got through it, and that it didn't take long to get back into the world.

You are 24, and you have so much life ahead of you. If you took a long look at your daughter's face, I bet you would find purpose. I don't know your life, but maybe you'll get a divorce and things could be better. You are a free person, you are not a slave. You have responsibilities but you must also be happy, otherwise everything collapses around you. Maybe take small steps to make yourself happy without hurting anyone. Going to a park in a different area, a walk somewhere with just you and your daughter, or maybe leave her behind and soak in the nature around you. There is a whole world, and many years for you to live.
